description:
Retire one steering rule so no later iteration prompt carries it.

    Pass the project id and the rule `id` from list_steering_rules. Works for
    an active or a pending rule, including a retro kaizen the automatic
    curation pass protects. The rule's text and history are kept and the
    retirement appears in Loop Activity. A rule that is already retired
    returns `changed: false`. There is no un-retire: to bring a convention
    back, submit it as a new Request. Running iterations keep the prompt they
    started with.
name: retire_steering_rule
title: Retire Steering Rule
